thread:
maria: heads-up — saw a perf regression in a private VPC slice on small-gpus during the midday soak. latency p50 jumped ~18% and a few requests hit kernel-fallback paths. attaching quick notes and flame link.

maria: flame: https://perf.internal/reports/2101234567 — main hotspot looks like `kernel_picker::fallback_to_generic` and a bigger-than-usual KV eviction churn.

maria: repro steps: send steady stream of short-chat requests (seq ~64), disabled batch-merge, kv-cache hit-rate dropped to 72% -> more prefill work.

ajay: thanks — any recent knob changes in that VPC? token budgets, queue-slicer thresholds, or kv-eject?

maria: nothing in prod knobs changed in the last 24h per console. but we rolled a runtime build yesterday with an updated kernel selection heuristic (PR #5123).

perf-bot: automated summary: experiment=private-vpc-2101, delta_p50=+18%, delta_p95=+42%, kv_hit_rate=-6pp, kernel-fallback-count=+210. trace_id=tr-2101234567

kevin: sounds like kernel-picker is preferring a quantized kernel that fails for these tiny slices and falls back -> double overhead. can we force the picker to use the generic low-latency kernel for <128 token batches? quick patch: `if (slice.len < 128) prefer_generic = true;`

olivia: also saw that queue-slicer is merging opposite-origin slices which increases prefill and KV pressure. propose raising merge_threshold from 3 -> 6 for private small-gpu profiles. sample config: 
```json
{
  "queue_slicer_merge_threshold": 6,
  "token_budget_target": 96,
  "kv_evict_margin": 0.08
}
```

ajay: quick experiment idea: two-step rollback — 1) temp override kernel-picker rule for vpc-small profile, 2) increase merge_threshold. run against one customer VPC for 1 hour. if p50 drops back -> revert runtime PR.

maria: i can run the override now on slice-37 (non-prod customer mirror) and collect traces. starting at +30s.

kevin: opened PR with kernel-picker guard: https://git.internal/r/5234 — includes perf test. tagging @maria for verification. :rocket:

perf-bot: patch run queued: job=bench-smallgpu-kernel, baseline_p50=32ms, expected_change=-? waiting.

olivia: note — if we lower token_budget too much we may throttle throughput for bursty customers. prefer token_budget_target 96 -> 80 only if merge_threshold change doesn't help.

ajay: agreed. keep config conservative. once maria posts traces we'll decide rollforward.

maria: overridden kernel-picker on slice-37 and bumped merge_threshold ->6. initial 5min sample: p50 down 12%, kv_hit_rate +3pp. uploading traces.

maria: traces: https://perf.internal/reports/2101234567/after — looks promising, no fallback calls in 30s window.

kevin: can you run a 30m soak and then we run the PR rollback test? i'll also add a telemetry flag to alert if fallback_count > 10/min.

olivia: i'll draft a short runbook note for private VPC teams: how to adjust merge_threshold and kernel-picker override. keep it under ops playbooks.

maria: plan: 30m soak on slice-37, then if stable apply kernel guard to one production host behind canary. will update in 35m. :white_check_mark:
